questions.cardText:
[Political Science] What is the term for a system of government where power is held by a small group of people?
A. Autocracy
B. Oligarchy
C. Theocracy
Answer: B.
questions.de: Wie nennt man eine Regierungsform, in der die Macht in den Händen einer kleinen Gruppe von Menschen liegt?
questions.en: What is the term for a system of government where power is held by a small group of people?

timeline.labelEn: Aristotle describes oligarchy as a corrupt form of aristocracy (4th century BC)
timeline.labelDe: Aristoteles beschreibt die Oligarchie als entartete Form der Aristokratie (4. Jh. v. Chr.)

questions.cardText:
[Engineering and Invention] How was the Statue of Liberty constructed?
A. Solid bronze cast in multiple sections
B. Reinforced concrete with a steel skeleton
C. Iron frame with a thin copper layer
Answer: C. The Statue of Liberty was constructed with an iron framework designed by Gustave Eiffel, the same engineer behind the Eiffel Tower. A thin layer of copper, only 2.4 millimeters thick, was then hammered into place to form the statue’s outer surface. This innovation allowed the statue to withstand various weather conditions and the passage of time.
questions.de: Die Außenhaut der Freiheitsstatue besteht aus nur etwa 2,4 mm dickem Kupfer, das über ein von Gustave Eiffel entworfenes inneres Gerüst getrieben wurde – aus welchem Metall ist dieses Gerüst?
questions.en: The Statue of Liberty's outer skin is copper only about 2.4 mm thick, hammered over an internal framework designed by Gustave Eiffel — of what metal is that framework?

timeline.labelEn: The Statue of Liberty is dedicated in New York Harbor
timeline.labelDe: Die Freiheitsstatue wird im Hafen von New York eingeweiht

questions.notes: The copper sheets are 0.094 in (2.4 mm) thick; Eiffel and Maurice Koechlin designed the iron truss tower inside.
